name: posterior-tiers
title: Tiers from posterior summaries
idea: At one τ and cap, the risk never rises from posterior-mean tiers to the best cuts of their order to the best report of all, as each family holds the one before; on the eight units the last two coincide.
credit: League built for this site (the eight units are its U01–U08); 30-site example from the postrank package (synthetic); tiers after the postrank theory book, ch. 17.
caption: One supplied posterior and one withholding price for every rule; fixed tiers, optimized cuts within named orders, and exhaustive optimization only on the eight units.
